dataScope: Previously examined development cohort; no independent validation claim
baselineEligibility: Use actual app controller and existing short-prefix guard unchanged for every candidate
primarySelectionMetric: Equal-source-group mean fraction within 3 days; ties by lower equal-group MAE, then declared candidate order
historyInputs: Only the baseline-selected preceding intervals, at most six; no age, hormones, symptoms or unobserved physiology invented
trimmedMeanRule: Drop one smallest and one largest interval if at least five; otherwise mean
exponentialMeanRule: Weights 1, 0.5, 0.25 ... from newest to oldest, normalized
linearTrendRule: OLS on cycle index; clamp slope to [-1,1] day per cycle; predict next index; clamp result to [15,90] days
windowCenterRule: Integer center covering most prior observations within plus/minus 3 days; ties by distance to median then smaller center
personalExpertRule: Choose among first nine methods using last up to six earlier eligible predictions; require at least four; score within 3 days then MAE then declared order; otherwise baseline. Clear expert evidence after a withheld fold. Update only after issuing each forecast.
rounding: Positive estimates rounded half up, matching Dart
grouping: All histories with the same declared participant/source key remain together; unverified source histories are not asserted to be unique people
modelSelection: Select on other folds only; do not inspect held-out group scores for selection
uncertainty: 2000 paired source-group bootstrap resamples; percentile 95% intervals; seed 20261018; conditional on fixed out-of-fold predictions, not refit-model uncertainty
ninetyPercentGoal: Within 3 days, not an expanded interval; independent confirmatory lower 95% bound at least 0.90; prediction coverage at least baseline on identical eligible opportunities; clinician-approved supported population and prospective replication
